```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gdata)
library(ggnewscale)
```

```{r}
# LOCO data (with metacorr)
samafs_loco <- read.table("samafs_inflation_factor_loco_metacorr.txt", header = TRUE)
hchs_loco <- read.table("hchs-sol-inflation_factor_loco_metacorr.txt", header = TRUE)

# Non-LOCO data (with metacorr)
samafs_no_loco <- read.table("samafs_inflation_factor_data_metacorr.txt", header = TRUE)
hchs_no_loco <- read.table("hchs-sol-inflation_factor_data_metacorr.txt", header = TRUE)

df_loco <- gdata::combine(SAMAFS = samafs_loco, "HCHS/SOL" = hchs_loco) 
df_no_loco <- gdata::combine(SAMAFS = samafs_no_loco, "HCHS/SOL" = hchs_no_loco) %>% distinct()
```

# Figure A: Joint vs method inflation factor, colored by LOCO, faceted by dataset
# Two rows: sex-meta, sex-meta-corr
```{r}
combine_lambda_A <- merge(df_no_loco, df_loco, by = c("trait", "source")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(joint_lambda, meta_lambda, metacorr_lambda,
             joint_loco_lambda, meta_loco_lambda, metacorr_loco_lambda),
    names_to = c("method", "LOCO"),
    names_pattern = "(joint|meta|metacorr)_(loco_)?lambda",
    values_to = "lambda"
  ) %>%
  mutate(LOCO = ifelse(LOCO == "loco_", "used", "not used")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = method,
    values_from = lambda,
    names_glue = "{method}_lambda"
  )

# Reshape for faceting: one row per (trait, source, LOCO, y_method)
df_A <- combine_lambda_A %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(meta_lambda, metacorr_lambda),
    names_to = "y_method",
    values_to = "y_lambda"
  ) %>%
  mutate(y_method = case_when(
    y_method == "meta_lambda" ~ "sex-meta",
    y_method == "metacorr_lambda" ~ "sex-meta-corr"
  ))

df_A$y_method <- factor(df_A$y_method,
                        levels = c("sex-meta",
                                   "sex-meta-corr"))
```

```{r fig.width=7, fig.height=8}
figA <- ggplot(df_A, aes(x = joint_lambda, y = y_lambda)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.05,
             linetype = "solid", color = "gray", linewidth = 1,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.05,
             linetype = "solid", color = "gray", linewidth = 1,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1,
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(LOCO), alpha = 0.9), size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "LOCO") +
  guides(alpha = "none") +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(y_method), cols = vars(source)) +
  labs(
    x = "Joint analysis inflation factor",
    y = "Sex-stratified analysis inflation factor"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )

figA

ggsave(
  filename = "supp_figA_metacorr.pdf",
  plot = figA,
  width = 7,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

# Figure B: No-LOCO vs LOCO inflation factor, colored by method, faceted by dataset
# Now with 3 methods: joint, sex-meta, sex-meta-corr
```{r}
combine_lambda_B <- merge(df_no_loco, df_loco, by = c("trait", "source")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(joint_lambda, meta_lambda, metacorr_lambda,
             joint_loco_lambda, meta_loco_lambda, metacorr_loco_lambda),
    names_to = c("method", "LOCO"),
    names_pattern = "(joint|meta|metacorr)_(loco_)?lambda",
    values_to = "lambda"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    LOCO = ifelse(LOCO == "loco_", "loco", "no_loco"),
    method = case_when(
      method == "joint" ~ "joint",
      method == "meta" ~ "sex-meta",
      method == "metacorr" ~ "sex-meta-corr"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = LOCO,
    values_from = lambda
  )
```

```{r fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
figB <- ggplot(combine_lambda_B, aes(x = no_loco, y = loco)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.05,
             linetype = "solid", color = "gray", linewidth = 1,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.05,
             linetype = "solid", color = "gray", linewidth = 1,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1,
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(color = method, alpha = 0.9), size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Analysis",
                     values = c("joint" = "#F8766D", "sex-meta" = "#619CFF", "sex-meta-corr" = "#00BA38")) +
  guides(alpha = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ source) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Original inflation factor",
    y = "LOCO inflation factor"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )

figB

ggsave(
  filename = "supp_figB_metacorr.pdf",
  plot = figB,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```
